documentGenerations.authority: Generation receipts, SHA-256 input/source/template/output fingerprints and delivery attempts. Source domain stores and stored narrative/card snapshots retain their existing authority. Receipts are historical references, not live ownership links.
documentGenerations.migration: Absent means empty. Version-1 roots and all receipts are validated before every write; malformed or unsupported history blocks generation and remains untouched.
documentGenerations.backup: Exact bytes included in full recovery archives. Excluded from normal record transfers, avoiding importing another browser's generation/delivery claims as local events.
documentGenerations.locking: Web Locks serialize ledger writes across cooperating windows. Browser support and Web Crypto are required; there is no unsafe fallback. Locks protect this ledger, not unrelated workspace mutations.
documentGenerations.retention: No automatic deletion. Up to 5000 receipts and 100 delivery attempts per receipt; quota/limit failures block release. No raw inputs, medical text, filenames or generated document bodies are stored in the ledger.
documentGenerations.limitations: PENDING records can indicate active or interrupted generation. GENERATED means output bytes and receipt are complete, not that a printer/download/clipboard finished. Browser download/print submission is recorded separately. User-visible documents remain in their existing destinations; this ledger is not an immutable server audit log or a document archive.
